sentences.text: Eostegostoma belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, which includes cartilaginous fish, and is part of the family Brachaeluridae.
The genus was described by Herman and Crochard in 1977.
These animals lived between 85.7 and 27.3 million years ago, appearing in the Santonian to Rupelian stages.
Fossils have been found in the Eocene of Belgium and the Oligocene of Alabama, United States.
